sections.title: Fixes
items: Fixed a game crash that could happen right after your target died or despawned, often while a rotation was checking raid buffs before using a potion.

sections.title: Commands
items: Rotation setting commands now change the exact setting you name. Before, a setting whose name starts the same way could be changed instead, such as Warrior's YEET instead of YEETBurst.
Picking a list option by a negative number in a rotation setting command no longer causes an error. It now counts back from the end of the list.
Adding a number to /rotation Auto or /rotation TargetOnly now picks that targeting type even when RSR is off.
A command that is only a number, such as /rotation 3, is no longer read as a state.
Commands can no longer turn RSR on during a duty recorder playback.
/rotation Auto and /rotation Off are now listed in the /rotation help text. They were registered as separate commands, which the game can't run because of the space.

sections.title: Healing
items: Single target heals go to the lowest health party member again, with healers and tanks first under their own thresholds. Before, the pick skipped everyone who could be healed, so heals fell back to the tank or the first party member, and someone under Holmgang, Living Dead or HP Recovery Down was even preferred.
"Stop single target GCD healing after reaching threshold" works now. It never recognised any heal as one it could cancel.
Party health checks now count everyone in parties with chocobos or NPC members, so the ninth member is no longer left out.
A forced raise from the Raise special state no longer targets someone who is already being raised or who your raise settings leave out.

sections.title: Duties
items: New "Auto-use duty actions" setting in Auto > Action Usage and Control. Turn it off to stop RSR from using duty actions like Bozja Lost Actions, Phantom actions and Variant actions on its own.
Bozja's area heals can now be used by auto healing. Before, duty area heals were only tried in Occult Crescent and variant dungeons. Better support for Bozja actions is on my todo list.
Phantom Geomancer's Battle Bell is no longer placed on someone who already has another player's Battle Bell.
Hellmaker is now only prioritized while you're a Cell Block C or D prisoner, as intended.
The M10 Firesnaking/Watersnaking targeting setting now also works in the Normal version.

Crucible of the Unbroken, Ymir Piece: the Sahagin Piece is now prioritized until it has Paralyzing Spikes, then the Ymir Shell, then the Ymir Piece once its shell is gone. The spiked Sahagin is left alone while Ymir is up.
The Ymir logic now treats Ymir as immune while Ymir has Vulnerability Down. Before, it checked you for the buff instead, so it never worked.
Crucible of the Unbroken, Siren Piece: Crawling Pieces are now prioritized so they can't bind you in place.

sections.title: Targeting
items: When picking party members by role, Pugilists now count as melee DPS and Archers no longer count as casters. Idk I think I was tired.
The alliance list now fills in alliance content whatever your raise setting is, so "Auto turn on auto mode when alliance is in combat" works again.
Fixed issue with "Auto provoke when there is another tank in party" setting, it now works lol.
Auto tank stance no longer turns on while another tank in your party already has their stance on.
Fixed an issue where actions picked while a raise, Esuna or provoke is the next GCD would use the wrong target.
Fixed an issue with numbered treasure dungeon mobs not being attacked in order.
Targets that other plugins prioritize through IPC are now actually attacked first. Before, they were only allowed as targets.

In PvP, tanks and melee now use their attack oGCDs from 5y instead of waiting until 3y. On Gunbreaker this stopped Jugular Rip, Abdomen Tear, Eye Gouge and Hypervelocity from firing, which held up the rest of the rotation.

In PvP, single target actions on other players no longer get stuck at the edge of their range. The game measures PvP range half a yalm shorter than RSR did, so RSR kept trying actions on players the game said were out of range.

sections.title: Combat
items: Stopping a cast when the target dies works again. The delay before cancelling never finished, so casts were never stopped.
Raid buffs, Neutral Sect, Earthly Star and other actions with a time-to-kill limit are no longer held back for the first seconds of each pull or during downtime.
Fixed a rare issue where healing would pause in combat while no enemy's time to kill is known yet.
A heal is no longer forgotten when its target takes damage before it lands, so RSR no longer heals the same person twice.
Actions that need a status on the target, such as Deployment Tactics, can now be used until that status runs out, not only until two GCDs before.
"Record AoE actions" now records raid-wide casts again.
After BossMod Reborn is unloaded or RSR is turned off, RSR no longer keeps BossMod's last state, which in rare cases could stop all casting or cancel every cast.
Actions you turned off are no longer used right after a queued command action.
RSR now asks the game whether an ability can be used the same way it does for weaponskills and spells.
A failing rotation now logs its error once instead of every frame, and an error in the action preview no longer stops the rotation.
Fixes for "Remove extra lag-induced animation lock delay" and "Remove extra framerate-induced cooldown delay" tweaks in Extra menu.
Intercepted abilities that come off cooldown within the intercept window are now queued, the same as weaponskills and spells.
Minor fix to potion inventory stuff, now properly reads you have a potion available if you get it while RSR is active, if that makes sense idk its a minor thing.
Party buff timing, used by some extra rotations such as Churin's Dark Knight, now counts buffs and debuffs from other players.
Tankbuster targeting no longer holds on to characters from an earlier fight, a rare cause of crashes.
Starting auto-attack is no longer blocked by a no-casting status while RSR state is off, while this is technically beneficial to leave bugged I'd rather RSR not affect you when its not active'

sections.title: Clicking
items: The random delay between clicks is now spread evenly over the range you set, instead of usually landing near the shortest delay.
The number of simulated key presses can now reach the top of its range, it was bounding down on accident.
The click counter on the main menu now counts even when "Simulate the effect of pressing abilities" is off.

sections.title: Lists
items: If downloading a status or action list fails, RSR tries again next time instead of keeping an empty list.
The reset buttons on the lists no longer freeze the game while they download.
Lists are saved safely, so a crash while saving can't leave a list half written.
Editing a list now saves only that list instead of all of them.
The action picker on the Lists tab no longer offers actions without a name.

sections.title: Hotbars
items: Turning off the red tint for disabled actions now also clears it on hotbars that were hidden at the time.

sections.title: Language
items: Chinese translations show again, in every window and not only while the main window is open.

sections.title: Performance
items: Choosing targets and checking enemy casts takes much less work each frame, which should help with framerate cost especially on lower end machines.
Party membership, health and target lookups are now worked out once per frame instead of once per action, and target picks no longer sort whole lists to find one target.
Duty actions, Phantom job levels, raid buff tracking and the disabled-action hotbar tint now cost far less each frame, and RSR no longer polls BossMod for unused debug text.

sections.title: Tanks
items: Paladin's emergency Intervention now also works while Guardian is up.
Dark Knight only uses The Blackest Night on party members when that option is on.
Dark Knight's "Keep at least 3000 MP" option now keeps MP back when dumping Edge of Shadow in burst.

sections.title: Healers
items: White Mage no longer lets Divine Caress expire after Temperance.
White Mage only uses Thin Air right after a spell, and counts Medica III's regen when deciding whether to recast it.
Scholar uses Baneful Impaction before it expires, and removes Aetherpact through Dissolve Union.
Astrologian uses Sun Sign before Suntouched runs out, and its single-target shield no longer waits on Macrocosmos or Collective Unconscious.
Sage uses Rhizomata based on Addersgall instead of Addersting.

sections.title: Melee
items: Auto True North now waits until the last weave before the positional, giving you time to get into position first.
Auto True North is no longer used on enemies that are about to die, or when you're actually in position but standing at a different height or right on top of the enemy.
Monk lines up Brotherhood with Riddle of Fire and holds The Forbidden Chakra when Brotherhood is about to come up.
Monk uses Earth's, Fire's and Wind's Reply before they expire, and the "Use Form Shift" option now controls the pre-pull Form Shift.
Dragoon only uses Stardiver right after a weaponskill so it doesn't clip.
Dragoon saves Life Surge and Wyrmwind Thrust for Battle Litany or Life of the Dragon, and no longer holds Lance Charge for a full minute when it drifts.
Removed Dragoon's Doom Spike option, which had no effect.
Ninja uses Goka Mekkyaku with Kassatsu on groups of enemies instead of letting Kassatsu expire.
Ninja's "Use Mudras outside of combat" option now works. It is off by default.
Samurai's Higanbana target option no longer skips Higanbana's other checks when turned off.
Samurai uses Mangetsu correctly under Meikyo Shisui, and the Meikyo countdown slider now goes up to 20 seconds.
Reaper uses Enshroud based on the Shroud gauge or Ideal Host instead of the Soul gauge.

sections.title: Physical ranged
items: Bard no longer stops using weaponskills in some burst windows.
Bard no longer reapplies Caustic Bite or Venomous Bite early, and the Apex Arrow Soul Voice setting works below 100.
Removed Bard's unused oGCD slot option.
Machinist's Automaton Queen schedule now resets between pulls and runs to the end.
Machinist below level 90 uses Hypercharge at 100 Heat while Wildfire is on cooldown.

sections.title: Casters
items: Red Mage uses Impact in AoE with Dualcast or Acceleration, and uses Prefulgence before it expires.
Summoner's "Use Radiant Aegis on cooldown" option now works. When it's off, Radiant Aegis is kept for incoming damage.
Summoner uses Lux Solaris before Refulgent Lux runs out.
Pictomancer uses Tempera Grassa before Tempera Coat runs out.
Black Mage no longer spends Thunderhead while High Thunder is still ticking, and uses Triplecast before Occult Comet.
Removed unused Summoner and Black Mage options.

sections.title: Blue Mage and duties
items: Blue Mage's Devour and Missile HP thresholds now work, and its Mighty Guard and Basic Instinct options are respected.
Occult Crescent: Occult Ether and Occult Potion on other players now use the right action.
Occult Crescent: the Drain Touch and Occult Chakra HP thresholds now work.
Occult Crescent: Cannoneer no longer keeps targeting by HP after an immune enemy.

sections.title: PvP
items: Paladin's Guardian follows its HP threshold settings.
White Mage and Bard now use Guard, Recuperate and the Elixir like other jobs.
Reaper uses Fate Sealed before Death Warrant ends.

sections.title: General
items: Fixed the early-weave check, which always thought an oGCD had already been woven.
Fixed the source code links for several rotations.

sections.title: Settings window
items: A locked settings window now moves itself back on screen if it ends up partly off the edge, for example after a plugin update or a resolution change.

sections.title: Fixed invulnerability check caused by a double negative lol
items: Warrior now uses Nascent Flash on party members again. It was skipping every target that wasn't under an invulnerability.
Scholar now uses Recitation for Excogitation when a tank is low, instead of only when the tank is under an invulnerability.
Scholar now follows up Recitation with Excogitation when a tankbuster is coming. Before, Recitation was pressed but the Excogitation was held back.
Scholar can now use Excogitation and Indomitability with Recitation when out of Aetherflow, like the game allows.

sections.title: Beastmaster Fixes
items: Fixed some bugs with the Beastmaster rotation and added special handling for Ymir in 3rd board of the Crucible.

sections.title: Settings window
items: The settings window has a new lock button at the top right, next to minimize. While locked, the window can't be moved or resized, and it stays locked the next time you open it.

sections.title: Fixes
items: The settings, control and state windows no longer creep up and to the left by a pixel or two each time they are minimized and restored. I thought I was going crazy but it looks it was bug and is now fixed lol.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Fixed a game crash when the control window was open, most often on tanks using healing or party mitigation on someone who had left or despawned.

entries.title: Targets for DoActions and intercepted macros

sections.title: DoActions targets
items: DoActions can now end with a target, like a game macro: "/rotation DoActions Cure II-5 <f>".
Any placeholder the game's macros accept works, such as <t>, <f>, <tt>, <mo>, <me> and <2> to <8>.
Targeting types work too, such as <LowHP>, <Big>, <Nearest> or <HighHPPercent>. The target is picked when the action is used.
If the target can't be hit when the action fires (out of range, out of sight, or the placeholder found nothing), RSR picks the target like before.

sections.title: Intercepted macros
items: When an intercepted action comes from a macro, RSR now uses it on the target the macro picked, e.g. /ac "Cure II" <mo>.

sections.title: Stutter casting fixed (I hope)
items: Issue with BMR Movement causing movement/casting stuttering issues.

sections.title: Full Control Window
items: The AoE switch now sits directly under the Auto / Manual / Off switch, and its buttons are ordered Full, Cleave, Off so each one lines up under Auto, Manual and Off.
New link toggles between Auto and Full, and between Manual and Cleave. While linked, choosing that state in the Control window also sets the matching AoE type, like the State Window does.
The window remembers one width for when the special buttons are shown and another for when they're hidden.

sections.title: Padding
items: New "Padding" option in UI > Information scales the space around and between things in every RSR window, from 25% to 200%. Buttons, icons and text keep their size.
The settings window, State Window and Control window now use a tighter layout: thinner window edges, and less padding in cards, setting rows and the sidebar.

sections.title: Settings window
items: The search icon turns into a spinner while search results are showing. I just think its neat :)

entries.title: Various Minor Fixes + Autoduty IPC update

sections.title: Fixes to a bunch of little bits of the UI following feedback
items: Window fold labels have been updated.
Added setting to the Full Control Window to allow removing the state buttons for a more compact layout.
Added the ability to fold (minimize) the Full Control Window and State Window.
Fixed an issue with certain windows being permanently pinned if you had them pinned before 7.5.6.14.

sections.title: Autoduty IPC update
items: Autoduty IPC updated with new functionality.
Previously Autoduty would change your settings when controlling RSR and be unable to tell what they were so it would not change them back.
Now with the new Autoduty IPC settings no longer need to be changed by Autoduty, it will temporarily override them without changing them.

sections.title: Material Design 3 inspired interface redesign aka Reborn Material
items: The settings window, overlays and info windows have been rebuilt on a new Reborn Material design system.
New "Interface accent colour" option: pick one colour and every surface, button and highlight in RSR is derived from it.
New "Text size" option scales the text in every Rotation Solver window, on top of Dalamud's own font settings.
New "Element size" option scales the padding, spacing and controls in every Rotation Solver window. Turn it down for a more compact layout that needs less scrolling.
Setting descriptions can now be shown inline beneath each setting. Turn off "Show setting descriptions inline" for a denser list.

sections.title: Autorotation control window
items: /rotation Control opens a small window with Auto, Manual and Off buttons for switching the autorotation state.

sections.title: Next Action window
items: New "Show Keybind" option shows the keybind of the hotbar slot that holds the next action. Only visible hotbars are checked.
New "Window Size" option scales the whole Next Action window: the action icon, the GCD bar, the keybind and the target hint.

sections.title: Action Timeline window
items: Rebuilt in the Material 3 style. GCDs run along the top lane with their cast and recast, oGCDs sit beneath them, each action's animation lock is underlined, and auto-attacks tick along above the time axis.
Hard casts now appear the moment they start and fill in as they cast, and cancelled casts are marked in red.
Hover over an action for its name, timings and how long ago it was used. Hover over the window for buttons to lock it, open its settings or hide it.
New "Lock timeline" and "Timeline size" options. The timeline no longer shares the Control window's lock and background; it uses the Info window background.
Fixed "Save timeline to JSON file after combat" never saving while "Only show timeline in combat" was on. Each file now holds only the fight that ended, and records each action's ID.

sections.title: Removed
items: The Cooldown window has been removed, along with its settings and the per-action "Show on CD window" option. No one ever used this and I didn't want to have to go through updating it to Reborn Material standards.'

sections.title: First start tutorial
items: The first start tutorial has been rebuilt as a step-by-step tour with a step list to jump around in.
It now covers modes and how to switch between them, the settings window layout, your rotation, targeting, overlays and teaching mode, and more.
Change the settings that matter on day one right in the tour: accent colour, text size, AoE usage, auto on/off, hostile targeting and the overlay windows.
Reopen it any time from the About page.

sections.title: Update notes
items: This window! Update notes now appear after each update, along with credits for everyone who makes RSR possible.
Reopen them any time from the About page or with /rotation Changelog. The popup can be turned off in UI > Information.

sections.title: Rotations
items: Added Snarl and Challenge logic.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Fixed job gauge data after a Dalamud update.
Updated the invincible and no-casting status lists.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Fixed Warrior's Nascent Flash logic.
Fixed heal action selection when the target is yourself.

sections.title: Interface
items: Job icons in the UI now use the pixel art icons from deep dungeons.

sections.title: Performance
items: A refactor pass across the plugin for performance.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Various fixes to core logic, Beastmaster, healing logic and PvP Guard status logic.

sections.title: Translations
items: More of the interface is translated into Chinese.

sections.title: Rotations
items: Fixed Tempered Release.
Quelling Wave is now used more intelligently.
